summary_en: Lossless field-name comparison of all Departure and Demon King constants; matching names do not imply shared record identity.
summary_zh_cn: 对启程篇与魔王篇全部常量进行无损字段名对账；同名不代表共享记录身份。
comparison_key_policy: Strip only the exact EvolveBuild_ or EvolveBuildSC_ prefix; never infer identity from IDs, names or values.
stage_identity_policy: No cross-profile stage aliases are admitted; only exact shared StageConfig references from StagePeriod rows are shared.
